# Strong lighting

Bright light creates sharp tonal contrasts with brilliant highlightsand dark shadows, and throws detail into focus. Strong lighting works best when it comes froman angled source to emphasize the play of opposite endsof the tonal range. The Italian word chiaroscuro (meaning light-dark) is sometimes usedto describe how artists distribute lightand shade to depict form.
